lean.statement:
∀ {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ}
    (hκ : 4 ≤ κ) {ℓ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ),
    let j0 : Fin n := ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩
    let U : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ :=
      fun O => (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) j0 j0
    let a : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ :=
      fun O => κ + 1 + 4 * ℓ - (κ - 1) * U O
    let p : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ :=
      fun O x => Real.sqrt ((((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) - ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose))).det /
        (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) *
          Real.exp (-((WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ
            ((((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) - ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose)) *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x)) / 2)
    let t : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun x => Real.exp (-ℓ * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    let γ : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
      fun O => ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
        ((((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) - ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose)))⁻¹
    (∀ O, Integrable t (γ O) ∧ Integrable (fun x => t x * p O x) volume ∧
      (∫ x, t x ∂γ O) = ∫ x, t x * p O x) ∧
    Integrable (fun O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ =>
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * (∫ x, t x ∂γ O)) ((Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ)))) ∧
    (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * (∫ x, t x ∂γ O) ∂(Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ)))) =
      ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * (Real.sqrt κ - 1) ^ (n - 1) /
        (2 : ℝ) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)) *
        (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
          ((Real.sqrt κ + 1) * U O - (Real.sqrt κ - 1)) /
            (a O) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) ∂(Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ))))
approved_definition_context: The orthogonal group is full real O(n), both determinant signs, with inherited matrix Borel structure. Measure.haarMeasure(top : PositiveCompacts G) is the existing canonical normalized full-group Haar probability.

EuclideanSpace R (Fin n) uses the true Euclidean norm and canonical volume. WithLp.ofLp supplies coordinates and does not replace that norm with a Pi sup norm. All dimension-half powers use real division; n-1 uses natural subtraction.

The existing multivariateGaussian zero covariance C is the pushforward of canonical stdGaussian by z -> Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (CFC.sqrt C) z. Matrix inverse is the existing nonsingular inverse; the displayed source precision is positive definite in the numerical range, internally justified by existing results. No new Gaussian law is defined.

Integrable means genuine absolute Bochner L1 under the displayed measure. The first conjunction gives test Gaussian L1, weighted-volume L1 and pointwise equality; the second gives outer signed Haar L1, then the exact signed average. All L1 and transport claims are conclusions.
